sections.advice: Spittal an der Drau → Katschberg Pass climbs about 1641 m in 38 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Katschberg Pass → Mauterndorf drops about 1641 m over 12 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Mauterndorf → Obertauern climbs about 1738 m in 19 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Obertauern → Radstadt drops about 1738 m over 21 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

scenicChapters.title: Malta High Alpine Road
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 38 km. 1641 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Katschberg and Obertauern Route
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 1641 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

katschberg-and-obertauern-route.story: 91 km one way from Spittal an der Drau - plan on about 1 h 30 of riding. It goes by way of Katschberg Pass, Mauterndorf and Obertauern. The highest point is about 1,800 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
